Game Overview

Ninja Pig is a animal game built around unleash the stealthy prowess of an unlikely hero in Ninja Pig. Glide through ten thrilling levels, hurl shurikens at quirky alien foes, and aim for the high score. Embrace the unexpected agility of a purple piglet in this humorous platformer adventure that promises both laughter and adrenaline.
